name: Samson's mother
title: The Faithful Nazirite Mother
summary: Samson's mother was a devout woman from the tribe of Dan who was barren until an angel appeared to her with the promise of a son. She received instructions regarding the Nazirite vow and demonstrated faithfulness by carefully following God's guidance. Although she remains unnamed in the Bible, she plays a central role in the story of Israel's most powerful judge.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's First Appearance
keyEvents.description: The Lord's angel appeared to the barren woman and announced that she would give birth to a son who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Receiving Nazirite Instructions
keyEvents.description: The angel gave her specific instructions that she must not drink wine or eat anything unclean, and that her son was to be a Nazirite from birth.

keyEvents.title: Telling Manoah About the Vision
keyEvents.description: She went to her husband and told him about the divine revelation, describing the messenger as a man with an awe-inspiring appearance.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's Second Appearance
keyEvents.description: At Manoah's request, the angel returned, and the woman ran to fetch her husband so that he too could meet the messenger.

keyEvents.title: Calming Manoah after the theophany
keyEvents.description: When Manoah feared they would die because they had seen God, she showed insight of faith by saying that the Lord would not have accepted their offering if he intended to kill them.

keyEvents.title: Giving birth to Samson
keyEvents.description: She gave birth to a son and named him Samson, and the boy grew up and the Lord blessed him.
